name: Dens Blau
source:
Dens Blau is a common soldier of the Helman 2nd Army who serves as a member of [url=/c97641]Bitch Golch[/url]'s exploration party on the floating city of Ylapu in Rance IV. The team is tasked gaining control of the floating island in order for it to be used as a weapon by the militaristic nation.

[spoiler]Throughout his time on Ylapu, Dens was far more focused on providing emotional comfort to his friend [url=/c57068]Hubert Lipton[/url], who was in the process of grieving the apparent deaths of both his father [url=/c56830]Thoma Lipton[/url] and his best friend [url=/c42339]Patton Misnarge[/url] than he was in assisting Bitch in his mission. While Dens provided ample muscle and formidable fighting ability while exploring the floating city, particularly during his group's various conflicts against the Rance Rescue Team, he was unwilling to assist Bitch in performing his most depraved actions, to the point of freeing [url=/c14680]Masou Shizuka[/url] from his clutches after he had captured and attempted to rape her despite her being his enemy.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Dens_Blau]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
